title: Year 12 Physics Module 8 – From the Universe to the Atom
description: A fast-recall review of NSW Year 12 Physics Module 8, organised by its five Inquiry Questions. Questions use short answers and avoid multi-step calculations or extended writing.
author: Generated with Classroom Jeopardy Quiz Maker

categories.name: What evidence reveals the origins of the elements?

questions.prompt: What theory describes the Universe expanding from an early hot, dense state?
Which astronomer’s observations provided evidence that the Universe is expanding?
What shift in galaxy spectra is associated with galaxies moving away from us?
What diagram plots stellar luminosity against surface temperature or spectral class?
questions.answer: The Hertzsprung–Russell diagram. Accept: H–R diagram.

questions.prompt: What process forms new atomic nuclei inside stars?

categories.name: How do we know atoms contain protons, neutrons and electrons?

questions.prompt: What negatively charged particle was identified through cathode-ray experiments?
Which scientist measured the electron’s charge-to-mass ratio?
Which experiment measured the elementary electric charge using charged oil droplets?
Which scattering experiment provided evidence for a small, dense atomic nucleus?
questions.answer: The Geiger–Marsden experiment. Accept: Rutherford scattering or gold-foil experiment.

questions.prompt: Which scientist discovered the neutron?

categories.name: Why can’t classical physics explain the atom?

questions.prompt: What atomic model placed electrons in fixed, quantised energy levels?
What kind of spectrum from hydrogen shows discrete wavelengths rather than a continuous range?
questions.answer: A line emission spectrum. Accept: line spectrum.

questions.prompt: What visible hydrogen spectral series is described by the Balmer relationship?
Which scientist proposed that moving particles such as electrons have a wavelength?
questions.answer: Louis de Broglie. Accept: de Broglie.

questions.prompt: Which scientist developed the wave-mechanical description central to the modern quantum model of the atom?

categories.name: How can nuclear energy be harnessed?

questions.prompt: Which type of radiation consists of helium nuclei?
What term is the time taken for half the radioactive nuclei in a sample to decay?
What nuclear process splits a heavy nucleus into smaller nuclei?
What nuclear process joins light nuclei to form a heavier nucleus?
What difference between the mass of a nucleus and the total mass of its separate nucleons is linked to binding energy?

categories.name: How do we know our understanding of matter is incomplete?

questions.prompt: What fundamental particles combine to form protons and neutrons?
What family of particles includes the electron?
What is the quark composition of a proton?
questions.answer: Two up quarks and one down quark. Accept: uud.

questions.prompt: What theory classifies fundamental particles and three of the fundamental interactions?
What machines accelerate charged particles to high energies to test particle-physics theories?

finalRound.prompt: What equation links mass and energy and helps explain the enormous energy released in nuclear reactions and stars?
